_comment: Version-controlled knobs for the YOLO-World TensorRT build. Overrides the code defaults in build_policy.py. imgsz is HEIGHTxWIDTH and MUST be stride-32 multiples. The default 288x512 matches the 504x294 XTEND resize (landscape, aspect 1.78 vs 1.71) with minimal letterbox padding and ~2.8x fewer pixels than 640x640 -- the right trade for the 15 W DLA target. Use 640x640 for maximum open-vocab accuracy.
